purpose: PROPOSAL (RV-Y1, owner to approve): one in-product diagram replacing `flow-diagram` and `topology-diagram`. A naked root lays steps out and draws the connectors. **Data mode** (`nodes` + `edges`): edges set the columns and each node renders the richest card its data allows. **Composed mode**: hand-written parts in the default slot. `orientation="responsive"` stacks into a rail below a 36rem container.
useWhen: A request path or pipeline: steps in order joined by connectors.
A deployment or service topology with status, metrics, details and bind controls.
avoidWhen: A marketing architecture drawing from the official library → use `diagram`.
A numbered set of instructions → use `doc-steps`.
related: `status-indicator` — the status dot and text in a node header.
bestPractices: Prefer data mode; compose by hand only for markup the card cannot express.
Join adjacent columns; an edge that skips a column can cross it.
Put timing or failure on the edge (`label`, `severity`) when the hop failed, on the node when the resource did.
Use `orientation="horizontal"` for fixed-size scenes and mock-ups.
A one-resource slot puts `node-diagram-bind` in the `actions` slot.
